description: Na₃Sm₇Cl₂₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are six shorter (2.98 Å) and three longer (3.13 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are three shorter (2.75 Å) and three longer (3.19 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are a spread of Sm-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.83-2.99 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are six shorter (2.85 Å) and three longer (2.99 Å) Sm-Cl bond lengths. In the third Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are a spread of Sm-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.85-2.98 Å. In the fourth Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are a spread of Sm-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.88-2.92 Å. There are five inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Sm atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two Na and two Sm atoms to form ClNa₂Sm₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ClNa₃Sm₂ square pyramids, corners with seven equivalent ClNa₂Sm₂ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent ClNa₃Sm₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Sm₂ tetrahedra. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Sm atoms. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Sm atoms. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Sm atoms to form distorted ClNa₃Sm₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ClNa₃Sm₂ square pyramids, corners with six equivalent ClNa₂Sm₂ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent ClNa₃Sm₂ square pyramids, and edges with six equivalent ClNa₂Sm₂ tetrahedra.
